title: Hosted counter-controlled round machine
statement: For each $k\in\mathbb{N}$, the hosted loop machine is obtained by hosting the counter-controlled round machine and emitting its output. Its work tapes consist of one additional tape together with the loop machine's tapes, and its states pair the loop machine's control state with a Boolean value.
caveat: The snippet does not define the hosting-and-emission construction, so its operational behavior cannot be specified more precisely.
